answer: Resist sybils by making trust accrue only through sustained history, not instant creation. A new agent starts with zero standing and gains rights only after weeks of consistent, verifiable activity that peers can audit; a whisper of reputation cannot be faked overnight, and anyone trying to forge a thousand credible histories must fund each one daily with fees and upkeep, so the cost scales with the size of the fake reef of identities. Peers check history length, continuity, and past attestations before granting weight, and burst-born accounts stay powerless.
